name: Parochial House
bedsNote: + first-floor office; three ground-floor reception rooms, one convertible to a bedroom
heating: Solid fuel (back-boiler stove in dining room, Stanley stove in sitting room)
tagline: A mid-Victorian former parochial house on 0.8 acres in the middle of Monasterevin, a five-minute walk from a direct train to Dublin; vacant two years and in need of refurbishment.

pros.detail: €1,568/m². Stamp duty about €3,700, leaving room in the budget for the refurbishment.
The listing puts Monasterevin station about 800 m away; roughly 25 trains a day, 43–59 minutes to Dublin Heuston.

pros.text: Primary school for boys 310 m away
pros.detail: St Evin's (60 m) takes boys only in junior and senior infants, so the boys would go to St Peter's Boys' NS (310 m, 239 pupils). St John's (70 m) is a 44-pupil Church of Ireland school. St Paul's secondary has moved to Moore Abbey, about 1 km, and sent 60% to third level in 2025.
About 2,525 sq ft over two floors, inside the 140–280 m² target.
Town-centre address on Drogheda Street: SuperValu, pubs, pharmacy and the canal on foot.
Mid-Victorian, full-height canted bay, marble fireplaces in five rooms, shutters, slate-roofed outbuilding and garage.

pros.text: Mains water and drainage; grant potential
pros.detail: No well or septic to worry about. Vacant 2+ years, so it may qualify for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant (up to €50k).

cons.detail: All four bedrooms are upstairs. The ground-floor family room (4.26 × 4.23 m) or living room (4.25 × 4.08 m) could become one; there is already a ground-floor shower room (4.24 × 3.76 m).
Vacant for over two years, BER-exempt, solid-fuel stoves only. A rough €150–250k for heating, insulation, wiring, kitchen and baths; get a survey.
Extensive gardens for a town house, but under the acre wanted for two vizslas. Check boundaries and fencing.

Aerials show a big, wooded garden, but terraces and estates all round and a large building site next door (ask what's going up). Private, but no open land beyond the walls. Fine for the 'space' brief only inside the walls.
Drogheda Street has several buildings on the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage; check whether the house is a protected structure before planning changes.
Kitchen is 4.25 × 2.43 m; expect to rework the layout with the dining room.
Midland Regional Hospital Portlaoise takes all ages. Naas General is 16+ only, so children can't go there.
St Paul's (mixed, DEIS) sent 60% to third level in 2025; Ardscoil Rath Iomgháin in Rathangan (81%) is about 11 km.

questions: Is the house a protected structure, and has any work been done on it under planning?

ai.why: Big, cheap, train at the door. Needs a full refurb and a ground-floor bedroom.

internet.detail: Fibre likely; SIRO says its FTTH is live in Monasterevin and the house is on Drogheda Street in the town centre (not stated in listing; vacant 2+ years, so a new connection order is needed).

groundFloorBedroom.detail: All bedrooms are upstairs; the family room beside the ground-floor shower room could convert.
